description: This PHP source file serves as an example page demonstrating the use of the Kint debugging library. It includes class definitions, object instantiation, array manipulations, and rendering an HTML page with debugging and tracing functionalities.

classes.name: BaseUser
classes.description: A base class representing a user with a method to get full name.

classes.name: User
classes.description: A subclass extending BaseUser with additional properties and methods related to user data and configuration.

classes.name: UserManager
classes.description: A class for managing User objects, providing debugging and ensuring methods.

methods.name: getFullName
methods.description: Returns the full name of the user.

methods.name: isEqualTo
methods.description: Checks if the current user is equal to another user.

methods.name: setUsername
methods.description: Sets the username for the user.

methods.name: setAdditionalData
methods.description: Sets additional data for the user.

methods.name: getCreatedDate
methods.description: Returns the creation date of the user.

methods.name: setCreatedDate
methods.description: Sets the creation date for the user.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves the user managed by UserManager.

methods.name: debugUser
methods.description: Sets a user object for debugging.
